kicker: FOR B2B SAAS FOUNDERS AND HEADS OF GROWTH
headline: Your pricing page is quietly losing you deals every single week and nobody on your team has noticed it yet
body: Five concrete fixes you can ship this week without a redesign, a new tool or a pricing consultant on retainer.

headline: Lead with the outcome your buyer is paying for, not the feature list you built
before: Starter, Pro and Enterprise tiers, each with a 40 row feature comparison table that nobody reads past the third row
after: One plan per outcome, priced on the result the buyer gets, with the three features that justify the price and nothing else

headline: Annual billing toggles pay for themselves within the first quarter of the change
stat_label: in extra annual recurring revenue from changing a single default on the pricing page
body: Default the toggle to annual, show the monthly equivalent next to it, and put the saving in the button label so it is impossible to miss.

headline: Kill every one of these on sight before your next launch
lead: Every single one of these quietly costs you signups:
items: Contact sales buttons on every tier including the cheapest one
Feature comparison grids with forty or more rows
Hidden overage pricing that only appears at checkout
No free trial or a trial that asks for a card
Currency that does not match the visitor location
A FAQ that answers questions nobody asked
footnote: Fix one of these per week and measure signups every Friday.

kicker: Now you know the 5 fixes that recover lost pricing page deals
